sentences.text:
Petitioner
 Through: Mr. A.P. Dhamija, Mr. J.P. Singh and
 Mr. Triloki Pandit, Advs.
 versus

Respondent
 Through: Mr. Ritesh Kumar Bahri, App for

the State with SI Rajesh Kumar,
 DIU/Dwarka.
 CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANISH DAYAL  ORDER % 22.03.2023 CRL.M.A. 7491/2023 & CRL.M.A. 7492/2023 (Exemption)
1. Exemptions are allowed subject to all just exceptions.
1. This petition has been filed seeking regular bail for the petitioner in FIR No.176/2108 registered under Sections 420/467/468/471/120B/34 IPC at PS Dwarka North, New Delhi.

The petitioner has been in custody since 16.08.2022 and the chargesheet has been filed.
2. Issue notice.
3. Ld. APP accepts notice.

4. Status report be filed before the next date of hearing Nominal roll be also requisitioned from the Jail Superintendent and be placed on record.
CRL.M.(BAIL) 409/2023 1.

This application has been moved for interim bail to the petitioner during pendency of the case on the ground that the petitioner's father is suffering from last stage cancer and she has two minor children and there is nobody to look after and take care of the children.
The documents in support of the same have been filed as Annexure-P2 to the main petition, which may be duly verified by the State before the next date of hearing.
